timecoded_text_to_speech.text: You have a brand, and you want people to find out about it.
But in this competitive market, it's difficult to stand out and capture attention.
But what if your brand could serve ads that people actually want to see?
SmartLink gives marketers and creatives the tools to rapidly create, test, launch, and iterate
the best performing creative ads across social channels all from one platform, making it
fast and easy to maximize your results.
Here's how it works.
Create.
Upload your creative assets and transform them into stunning, on-brand ads with our creative
automation tools and templates.
Also, apply dynamic overlays with your catalog or data sources to automatically showcase
pricing, localized offers, copy variations, or even weather-based promos, personalizing
your ads.
Test.
Then, test your way to success.
Hone in on which specific elements people respond to through systematic and modular methods
to drive your results through the roof.
Launch.
Easily distribute your ads across multiple channels all from our platform, and then we get
to work.
Smash your performance goals with predictive algorithms that automatically adjust targeting
creatives, budgets, and bidding, saving you time and bringing you the highest conversion
rates.
Interate.
Make smarter decisions backed by data.
Our cross-channel, customized reporting, integrates all of your data and turns it into
real-time actionable insights.
More than just a platform, our performance and creative experts are your partner every
step of the way.
